content_items.title: Technology Is Not the Outcome. People Are.

idea.summary: Lead with a question about what communities actually gain from new technology.
idea.audience: School, nonprofit, and community organization leaders
idea.desired_action: Visit onanother.world to discuss an experience or program

creative_direction.opening_hook: What if the real measure of innovation was what it made possible for people?
creative_direction.core_tension: Organizations are asked to prepare communities for the future with limited tools and resources.
creative_direction.key_message: On Another World partners with organizations to bring purposeful immersive experiences to their communities.
creative_direction.visual_style: Warm founder-led delivery, community imagery with documented permissions, clean text overlays
claims_to_verify: Any participant count or measurable outcome added in a final edit
Rights and consent for images of participants

ai_work.task_prompt: Write a 45-second founder-led video script using the supplied message and a question-first hook.
ai_work.response_message: Draft script, LinkedIn caption, and production guidance prepared for human verification.

script.title: People Before Technology
script.body: What if the real measure of innovation wasn't the technology, but the possibilities it created for people? Across our communities, schools and organizations are doing essential work while the world changes around us. On Another World helps partners bring immersive experiences into that work, opening space for reflection, learning, and new perspectives. The future is human. Let's build experiences that help more people see what's possible. Explore a partnership at onanother.world.

captions.text: Technology is not the outcome. People are. The real question is how we help more communities experience what's possible. We're building partnerships around immersive learning, reflection, and future readiness. Let's connect: onanother.world

suggested_audience_replies.text: Appreciate you connecting. What community or audience are you hoping to serve? We'd love to explore how an activation could support your goals.
ResetXR uses guided immersive experiences paired with facilitation and reflection. Happy to share a sample program outline.

human_review_questions: Does the script position the partner as the hero?
Are all visuals cleared for use?

content_items.title: A Reset Moment Can Change the Conversation

idea.summary: Explain the value of short, guided immersive reflection without making clinical promises.
idea.audience: Event organizers, educators, and community leaders
idea.desired_action: Ask about bringing ResetXR to an event or program

creative_direction.opening_hook: What can ten intentional minutes make room for?
creative_direction.core_tension: Busy settings often leave little space to pause and reflect.
creative_direction.key_message: Guided immersive sessions can become a shared starting point for meaningful conversation.
creative_direction.visual_style: Calm pacing, real headset and facilitator footage, legible overlay text
claims_to_verify: Whether session duration matches the featured activation

ai_work.task_prompt: Create a 30-second vertical video script focused on a ResetXR session and follow-up reflection.
ai_work.response_message: Short-form script and Instagram caption ready. Please verify footage rights and session details.

script.title: The Reset Moment
script.body: What can ten intentional minutes make room for? A chance to pause. A chance to explore a new perspective. A chance to talk about what comes next. ResetXR brings guided immersive experiences into the spaces where communities already gather, with real people facilitating and reflecting together. Reset your mind. Expand your perspective. Discover ResetXR at onanother.world.

captions.text: The most powerful part of an experience might be the conversation it starts afterward. ResetXR brings guided immersive moments into community programs and events. Let's explore what's possible together: onanother.world

suggested_audience_replies.text: Thanks for asking! Tell us your city, event date, and expected audience, and we can discuss an activation that fits.

human_review_questions: Is the format compelling in 30 seconds?
Does the video avoid clinical claims?

content_items.title: Future Readiness Is Bigger Than Technical Skills

idea.summary: Introduce Chasing Dreams through a human development and workforce-readiness lens.
idea.audience: Workforce development leaders and youth-serving organizations
idea.desired_action: Connect about a program or pilot

creative_direction.opening_hook: Are we preparing young people to use technology, or to shape what comes next?
creative_direction.core_tension: Future readiness also depends on confidence, perspective, and practical skills.
creative_direction.key_message: Chasing Dreams combines future-oriented learning with human development and opportunity exploration.
creative_direction.visual_style: Bold headline slides, warm portrait photography with usage rights, simple graphic system
editing_notes: One clear CTA on final slide
claims_to_verify: Exact availability and scope of any proposed Chasing Dreams program
Any partner logo or student image permissions

ai_work.task_prompt: Write a five-slide LinkedIn carousel about youth future readiness and ownership.
ai_work.response_message: Carousel slide copy and content direction generated; program claims need human confirmation.

script.title: Future Readiness Carousel Slides
script.body:
Slide 1: Are we preparing young people to use technology, or to shape what comes next?
Slide 2: Access matters. But access alone is not the finish line.
Slide 3: Confidence, creativity, and decision-making matter too.
Slide 4: Chasing Dreams explores future readiness through skills, perspective, and possibility.
Slide 5: Let's build more pathways together. Explore a partnership at onanother.world.

captions.text: Future readiness is about more than access to tools. It's also about confidence, perspective, and the opportunity to build. We're exploring that connection through Chasing Dreams. Who is helping young people move from access toward ownership?

suggested_audience_replies.text: Appreciate your interest. What age group and learning goals are you working with? We'd love to compare notes on potential pilot approaches.

human_review_questions: Does the carousel lead to a conversation?

content_items.title: The Future Needs More Builders and Owners

idea.summary: Invite builders, mentors, and community leaders into a conversation about creating opportunity.
idea.audience: Technology creators, founders, mentors, and community advocates
idea.objective: Encourage thoughtful replies and new connections
idea.desired_action: Reply with one practical way to expand ownership

creative_direction.opening_hook: Who gets to build and own the future we're all talking about?
creative_direction.core_tension: Participation in technology should include a pathway to building and ownership.
creative_direction.key_message: Build networks that help talented people create and own new opportunities.
editing_notes: Under 500 characters for Threads, including spaces and hashtags
claims_to_verify: Any numerical representation claims added during editing

ai_work.task_prompt: Write a conversational Threads post under 500 characters on access, building, and ownership.
ai_work.response_message: Draft short-form post and a potential first-comment response for review.

script.title: The Future Needs Builders
script.body: Who gets to build and own the future we're all talking about? I believe access to tech is only the beginning. We need more pathways for people to create, lead, and own what comes next. I'm building toward that future with founders, young people, and community partners. What's one opportunity you wish existed when you started?

captions.text: Who gets to build and own the future we're all talking about? I believe access to tech is only the beginning. We need more pathways for people to create, lead, and own what comes next. What's one opportunity you wish existed when you started?

suggested_audience_replies.text: My answer: opportunities to learn by building real things with experienced people willing to open doors. What's yours?
Love this perspective. What are you currently building or supporting?

human_review_questions: Does the post sound authentic to the founder?
Is the Threads character limit respected?
Will the final question spark useful discussion?
